character: big bronze turkey in a floppy sun hat and floral shorts, ploughs forward body first, fills two thirds of the frame
props: bulging beach bag on one wing; huge striped umbrella dragging a furrow behind him; inflatable crocodile under his other wing; three swim rings stacked on his neck; four downy chicks with water pistols; oval gilded platter half-sunk in the sand ahead; coloured plastic buckets of potatoes and carrots; a pig with a crate of oranges; a fox with a coriander bunch, dill sprig behind her ear; a knife and fork in every guest's hands; photographer with a tripod camera; finally a printed photo, white lower strip, handwritten caption Сочи, 2026
motion_rule: the chicks touch him every window before 2.8, the guests touch the platter every window from 3.6 to 7.4; new angle and shot size every window; nobody merely stands
environment: bright sunny midday beach, wet sand, hard shadows, sea behind; background under a third of the frame

audio.sfx: sand scraping, water pistols squirting, umbrella dragging, rings squeaking, vegetables and oranges drumming on the platter, shutter click, gull cry, wind

timeline.a: ploughs along the wet sand, bag bouncing, umbrella cutting a furrow, crocodile under his wing, three rings on his neck | four chicks sprint round his legs
swats at the chicks without breaking stride, the swim rings swinging up into his beak | chicks pump their pistols, jets crossing the lens
turns his head straight into a jet, water bursts on his eye, hat knocked back | the nearest chick keeps firing
his soaked eye judders in short spasms, beak shut tight | the crocodile slides out from his wing
trips over the crocodile and topples forward, bag, umbrella and rings flying wide, lands chest first in the oval platter
sprawls in the platter, legs kicking | holidaymakers in swimsuits, sunglasses and hats sprint in from every side
heaves up on one wing elbow | guests tip coloured buckets around the platter rim, potatoes and carrots rolling into a ring
flops back, buried to the chest | the pig upends her crate and oranges bounce across him
lifts his head and glares | the fox strides in, dill behind her ear, and lays the coriander bunch across his back
sags flat, eye still twitching | everyone drops into a group-photo arrangement around the platter, knives and forks raised, all beaming
the photographer scrambles onto a cooler behind his tripod and fires the shutter | the ring of guests freezes mid-smile
the frame turns into that printed photo, white strip below carrying the caption, the wind rips it up spinning at the lens
the photo tumbles along the beach, a gull snatches it in its beak in mid-air and beats away over the sea

must_appear: sun hat, bag, umbrella, crocodile and three rings from 0.0; the jet hits his eye at 1.6; he lands in the platter at 2.8; oranges at 5.1; the herb bunch on his back at 5.8; knives and forks raised at 6.6; the photo with its caption fills the screen at 8.2; the gull takes it by 10.0
negative_prompt: night, dark scene, dusk, watermark, subtitles, static camera, same shot size twice, only his head moving, a window where nothing moves, the chicks away from him before 2.8, guests idle before 6.6, deformed anatomy, character changing mid-shot, speech, dialogue, moving lips, any letters anywhere except the caption on the photo strip, kitchen
